Phyllosticta_Leaf_Spot.quote: Symptoms of phyllosticta needle blight are typically browning tips.
later small, black fungal fruiting bodies containing spores develop on the diseased needles

Rhizosphaera_Needle_Cast.quote: Tiny black bumps can be seen arranged in neat rows on infected needles. These are the spore producing structures of the Rhizosphaera fungi.
the older needles turn brown to purple
